questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: Frames 7 through 11 clearly show the board fully in view with exactly three pens arranged in a row.
The middle pen is oriented differently or uncapped compared to the outer two. The outer two have black caps at the bottom, while the middle pen has a writing tip at the bottom.
All three pens have clear/translucent barrels and black components (caps or tips), appearing to be the same model of pen.
The middle pen clearly shows a bare writing tip at the bottom, while the left and right pens have black caps covering the bottom end. This indicates a missing cap on the middle pen.
The board moves steadily from left to right across the sequence of frames without visible pausing or reversing.
The pens remain fixed in their relative positions on the board throughout the movement.

parsed.reason: The middle pen is uncapped and shows a writing tip, while the other two pens are capped. This violates the condition that all pens must be complete and capped.
